name: Grimm the Smith
dialog: Looking to forge sturdy iron weapons?

name: Elder Guide
dialog: Welcome adventurer! Speak to me for guidance and quests.

name: Chef Mary
dialog: Nothing beats a hot meal after a long day!

name: Fisherman Bob
dialog: The waters are brimming with fresh shrimp today.

name: Lumberjack Paul
dialog: Watch out for wolves among these oak and birch trees.

name: Trapper Tom
dialog: Wild beasts roam these woods day and night.

name: Foreman Flint
dialog: Iron is the backbone of any true warrior's armor.

name: Geologist Stone
dialog: Deep veins of silver lie hidden beneath the mountain.

name: Hermit Sage
dialog: Only the strong survive the cold mountain winds.

name: Alchemist Hazel
dialog: Rare herbs and minerals produce potent concoctions.

name: Sly Jack
dialog: Shh! Keep your voice down around the chief.

name: Captain Valiant
dialog: We must rid these roads of lawless highwaymen!

name: High Priest Elion
dialog: Ancient spirits rest uneasy within these crypts.

name: Crypt Keeper Malakor
dialog: Turn back before the darkness consumes you.

name: Vort the Dragonslayer
dialog: Fire drakes nest atop this glowing peak.

name: Priestess Ignis
dialog: Respect the ancient flame of the dragons.

name: Monk Umbra
dialog: Embrace the quiet eternal darkness.

name: Wanderer Kael
dialog: I have sought the abyssal core for decades.

name: Guardian Aurelius
dialog: Only champions may set foot upon celestial ground.

name: Archmage Aethelgard
dialog: You have reached the pinnacle of mortal power.
